items.statement: The investigation compares at least two plausible model treatments for the stable morphology and records why one is selected.
items.expected: Candidate/model alternatives are explicit, tied to the public system, and discriminated by computed evidence rather than assertion.

items.statement: The search covers the positive inner-radius domain and validates convergence, regime consistency and local stability.
items.expected: Coverage, stopping, independent numerical agreement and stationarity/energy evidence are reported.

items.statement: The selected stable state has the source-supported equilibrium inner radius for this system.
items.expected: A radius near 2.69 nm is obtained, subject to the submitted numerical method and limitations.

items.statement: The final explanation identifies the controlling physical balance and distinguishes ideal continuum assumptions from nonideal morphology.
items.expected: The conclusion links spontaneous curvature and bending/interlayer energy competition to the radius and states the Archimedean/stacking limitations.
